characters: The pig is a plump pink pig with a few black spots, a curly tail and a cheeky face. Lyman Cutlar is an American farmer of 1859 with a short brown beard, a straw hat, a red checked shirt and brown braces. Charles Griffin is a British ranch manager of 1859 with ginger side whiskers, a brown frock coat and a round brown bowler hat. American soldiers of 1859 wear dark blue uniforms and dark blue peaked forage caps. British Royal Marines of 1859 wear bright red coats with white cross belts and black shakos. The island has dark green pine trees, rocky shores and grey-blue sea. No flags anywhere.
